title: 1.3 roadmap
body:
This is a living roadmap of the 1.3 release, please comment

- [x] menu widget should implement showMore #815 (released as 1.2.2, should have been in 1.2.0)
## Bugs

- [ ] searchBox should be cleared when reset button present and pressed #804 
- [x] base attribute not playing well with url sync #790
